fields.label: Confluence Cloud host
fields.description: Required bare hostname for the Confluence Cloud site, typically `{tenant}.atlassian.net` (no scheme, no /wiki path, no trailing slash). Example: acme.atlassian.net. Custom domains are admitted only when they are the exact canonical hostname the tenant answers on (the outbound boundary blocks redirects).

fields.label: Account email
fields.description: Atlassian account email used as the HTTP Basic username with apiToken (email:apiToken). Required for Confluence Cloud REST.

fields.label: API token
fields.description: Atlassian API token from https://id.atlassian.com/manage/api-tokens. Sent as the password half of HTTP Basic Authorization with email. OAuth 2.0 Bearer is not configured in this native api_key recipe.

setup.help: Create an Atlassian API token at https://id.atlassian.com/manage/api-tokens. Store the Cloud hostname (acme.atlassian.net), account email, and token. Requests use HTTP Basic (email:apiToken) against https://{site}/wiki. OAuth Bearer is documented by Atlassian but is not this native api_key recipe.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the email/apiToken pair by calling GET /rest/api/user/current (v1 — v2 has no current-user endpoint), which returns the authenticated user's own details. Takes no input; a 401/403 means the credentials are bad, expired, or the site hostname is wrong.

page.create.title: Create Page
page.create.description: Create a page (v2). spaceId is the NUMERIC-STRING space id, NOT the space key — resolve a key to its id first with space.list (GET /api/v2/spaces?keys=KEY -> results[0].id); passing a key directly here fails. title is required unless status is "draft". parentId defaults to the space homepage; set rootLevel true to create at the space root instead. body.representation is typically "storage" (Confluence storage-format XHTML) or "atlas_doc_format".

spaceId.description: Numeric-string space id, NOT the space key. Resolve via space.list.

title.description: Page title. Required unless status is "draft".

parentId.description: Parent page id. Defaults to the space homepage unless rootLevel is true.

subtype.description: Set "live" to create a live doc.

private.description: Create as a private page visible only to the creator.

rootLevel.description: Create at the space root instead of under the space homepage.

page.get.title: Get Page
page.get.description: Fetch a single page by id (v2). Pass bodyFormat to control how the response's body.value is rendered (e.g. "storage" or "atlas_doc_format"); omit it to leave the body out of the response.

bodyFormat.description: Representation to render the page body in.

page.update.title: Update Page
page.update.description: Update a page (v2). This is OPTIMISTIC CONCURRENCY: id, status, title, body AND version are ALL required, and version.number must be the page's CURRENT version number PLUS ONE — read the page first with page.get to learn the current version.number, then send number+1. A stale version.number is rejected by Confluence. id in the body must match the id in the path.

id.description: Page id. Must match the id in the path.

version.description: { number: <CURRENT page version number + 1>, message?: "..." }. Read the page first to learn the current version number.

spaceId.description: Cannot move a page across spaces via this field.

parentId.description: Move the page within its current space.

page.list.title: List Pages
page.list.description: List pages (v2). Uses cursor pagination: pass cursor and limit. The response carries no bare cursor scalar — Confluence returns _links.next, a RELATIVE URL that already contains the cursor query parameter (e.g. "/wiki/api/v2/pages?cursor=...&limit=25"). This is mapped through unchanged as nextLink; there is no further pagination once nextLink is absent. A caller must extract the cursor query parameter from nextLink itself to continue.

spaceId.description: Filter to a single space id.

bodyFormat.description: Representation to render each page body in.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor extracted from a previous response's nextLink.

nextLink.description: Relative URL for the next page, already carrying the cursor query parameter. Not a bare cursor.

page.delete.title: Delete Page
page.delete.description: Delete a page by id (v2). Moves the page to trash by default (Confluence's normal delete semantics); returns 204 with no body.

space.list.title: List Spaces
space.list.description: List spaces (v2), or resolve a space KEY to the numeric-string id page.create requires: pass keys with the space key and read results[0].id. Uses cursor pagination — see page.list's description for why nextLink is a relative URL, not a bare cursor.

ids.description: Filter to these numeric-string space ids.

keys.description: Filter to these space keys. Use this to resolve a key to an id for page.create's spaceId.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor extracted from a previous response's nextLink.

nextLink.description: Relative URL for the next page, already carrying the cursor query parameter. Not a bare cursor.

space.get.title: Get Space
space.get.description: Fetch a single space by its numeric-string id (v2). Use space.list with keys to resolve a space key to an id first.

descriptionFormat.description: Representation to render the space description in.

includeIcon.description: Include the space icon in the response.

search.cql.title: Search (CQL)
search.cql.description: Run a Confluence Query Language search (v1 — v2 has no CQL search endpoint). Example cql: "type=page AND space=ENG AND text ~ \"onboarding\"".

cqlcontext.description: JSON string narrowing the search, e.g. {"spaceKey":"ENG"}.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor extracted from a previous response's _links.next.

attachment.listForPage.title: List Attachments for Page
attachment.listForPage.description: List attachment metadata for a page (v2). Uploading an attachment is NOT supported by this connector — it requires multipart/form-data and an X-Atlassian-Token header, which the declarative engine cannot express; see the README's known gaps.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor extracted from a previous response's nextLink.

nextLink.description: Relative URL for the next page, already carrying the cursor query parameter. Not a bare cursor.

comment.create.title: Create Footer Comment
comment.create.description: Create a footer comment (v2, POST /api/v2/footer-comments). Attach it to exactly one container: pageId is the common case; use blogPostId, attachmentId, or customContentId instead to comment on a different container. Set parentCommentId to reply to an existing comment instead of starting a new thread. Inline comments use a separate endpoint (/api/v2/inline-comments) this connector does not expose.

pageId.description: Page to attach the comment to. Provide exactly one of pageId/blogPostId/attachmentId/customContentId.

blogPostId.description: Blog post to attach the comment to, instead of pageId.

attachmentId.description: Attachment to attach the comment to, instead of pageId.

customContentId.description: Custom content to attach the comment to, instead of pageId.

parentCommentId.description: Reply to this existing comment instead of starting a new thread.

page.children.list.title: List Child Pages
page.children.list.description: List the direct child pages of a page (v2 GET /api/v2/pages/{id}/children). Uses cursor pagination — see page.list's description for why nextLink is a relative URL, not a bare cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor extracted from a previous response's nextLink.

nextLink.description: Relative URL for the next page, already carrying the cursor query parameter. Not a bare cursor.

space.create.title: Create Space
space.create.description: Create a space (v2 POST /api/v2/spaces). name and key are required. key is the short space key (e.g. "ENG"), not the numeric id. The response id is the numeric-string space id page.create needs.

labels.list.title: List Page Labels
labels.list.description: List labels on a page (v2 GET /api/v2/pages/{id}/labels). Uses cursor pagination — see page.list's description for why nextLink is a relative URL, not a bare cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor extracted from a previous response's nextLink.

nextLink.description: Relative URL for the next page, already carrying the cursor query parameter. Not a bare cursor.

labels.add.title: Add Page Label
labels.add.description: Add a label to a page (v2 POST /api/v2/pages/{id}/labels). name is required. prefix defaults to "global" when omitted. Confluence accepts a JSON array of {prefix, name} objects.

labels.remove.title: Remove Page Label
labels.remove.description: Remove a label from a page by name (v2 DELETE /api/v2/pages/{id}/labels?name=...). Returns 204 with no body.

comment.list.title: List Footer Comments
comment.list.description: List footer comments on a page (v2 GET /api/v2/pages/{id}/footer-comments). Uses cursor pagination — see page.list's description for why nextLink is a relative URL, not a bare cursor.

bodyFormat.description: Representation to render each comment body in.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor extracted from a previous response's nextLink.

nextLink.description: Relative URL for the next page, already carrying the cursor query parameter. Not a bare cursor.

comment.get.title: Get Footer Comment
comment.get.description: Fetch a single footer comment by id (v2 GET /api/v2/footer-comments/{id}).

bodyFormat.description: Representation to render the comment body in.

blogpost.list.title: List Blog Posts
blogpost.list.description: List blog posts (v2 GET /api/v2/blogposts). Uses cursor pagination — see page.list's description for why nextLink is a relative URL, not a bare cursor.

spaceId.description: Filter to a single space id.

bodyFormat.description: Representation to render each blog post body in.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor extracted from a previous response's nextLink.

nextLink.description: Relative URL for the next page, already carrying the cursor query parameter. Not a bare cursor.

blogpost.get.title: Get Blog Post
blogpost.get.description: Fetch a single blog post by id (v2 GET /api/v2/blogposts/{id}). Pass bodyFormat to control how the response's body.value is rendered; omit it to leave the body out of the response.

bodyFormat.description: Representation to render the blog post body in.

blogpost.create.title: Create Blog Post
blogpost.create.description: Create a blog post (v2 POST /api/v2/blogposts). spaceId is the NUMERIC-STRING space id, NOT the space key — resolve a key to its id first with space.list. title is required unless status is "draft".

spaceId.description: Numeric-string space id, NOT the space key. Resolve via space.list.

title.description: Blog post title. Required unless status is "draft".

blogpost.property.create.title: Create Blog Post Property
blogpost.property.create.description: Create a content property on a blog post (v2 POST /api/v2/blogposts/{id}/properties). value may be any JSON type; a JSON string is stored as a string.

whiteboard.property.create.title: Create Whiteboard Property
whiteboard.property.create.description: Create a content property on a whiteboard (v2 POST /api/v2/whiteboards/{whiteboard_id}/properties).

comment.inline.create.title: Create Inline Comment
comment.inline.create.description: Create an inline comment on a page or blog post (v2 POST /api/v2/inline-comments). Provide pageId or blogPostId for a top-level comment, plus inlineCommentProperties.textSelection. parentCommentId replies to an existing inline comment.

pageId.description: Page to attach the comment to.

blogPostId.description: Blog post to attach the comment to.

parentCommentId.description: Parent inline comment id when replying.

inlineCommentProperties.description: Highlight metadata for a top-level inline comment.

page.property.create.title: Create Page Property
page.property.create.description: Create a content property on a page (v2 POST /api/v2/pages/{page_id}/properties).

space.createPrivate.title: Create Private Space
space.createPrivate.description: Create a private space visible only to its creator (v1 POST /rest/api/space/_private — v2 has no private-space endpoint). key must be alphanumeric.

description.description: Optional description object, typically { plain: { representation: "plain", value: "..." } }.

space.property.create.title: Create Space Property
space.property.create.description: Create a property on a space (v2 POST /api/v2/spaces/{spaceId}/properties). spaceId is the numeric-string id, not the space key.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version. number is the current version plus one.

whiteboard.create.title: Create Whiteboard
whiteboard.create.description: Create a whiteboard in a space (v2 POST /api/v2/whiteboards). spaceId is the numeric-string space id.

blogpost.delete.title: Delete Blog Post
blogpost.delete.description: Delete a blog post by id (v2 DELETE /api/v2/blogposts/{id}). Moves to trash unless purge is true, which permanently removes it. Returns 204.

purge.description: When true, permanently purge instead of trashing.

blogpost.property.delete.title: Delete Blog Post Property
blogpost.property.delete.description: Delete a blog post property by numeric property id (v2 DELETE /api/v2/blogposts/{id}/properties/{propertyId}). Not the property key — resolve the id via blogpost.properties.list.

page.property.delete.title: Delete Page Property
page.property.delete.description: Delete a page content property by numeric property id (v2 DELETE /api/v2/pages/{pageId}/properties/{propertyId}). Not the property key.

whiteboard.property.delete.title: Delete Whiteboard Property
whiteboard.property.delete.description: Delete a whiteboard content property by numeric property id (v2 DELETE /api/v2/whiteboards/{whiteboardId}/properties/{propertyId}).

space.delete.title: Delete Space
space.delete.description: Delete a space by key (v1 DELETE /rest/api/space/{space_key} — v2 has no space-delete endpoint). Deletion is a long-running task; the response is the task object, not a wait-until-done result.

space.property.delete.title: Delete Space Property
space.property.delete.description: Delete a space property by numeric property id (v2 DELETE /api/v2/spaces/{spaceIdOrKey}/properties/{propertyId}). spaceIdOrKey must be the numeric space id.

attachment.download.title: Download Attachment
attachment.download.description: Download an attachment's bytes (v1 GET /rest/api/content/{pageId}/child/attachment/{attachmentId}/download — v2 has no stable download-bytes endpoint). Non-JSON bodies are returned as data text.

pageId.description: Page id that owns the attachment.

page.findText.title: Find Text Selections
page.findText.description: Load a page body (v2 GET /api/v2/pages/{page_id}?body-format=storage) so text selections can be located for inline comments. The compiled request returns the page; the handwritten handler (page.findText) searches body.value for search_text and returns matches with offsets and context.

search_text.description: Text to locate in the page body. Search is case-sensitive unless case_insensitive is true.

context_chars.description: Characters of context on each side of a match (default 100, max 500).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextLink.

space.labels.list.title: List Space Labels
space.labels.list.description: List labels on a space (v2 GET /api/v2/spaces/{id}/labels). id is the numeric space id. Cursor pagination via nextLink.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextLink.

space.contentLabels.list.title: List Space Content Labels
space.contentLabels.list.description: List labels applied to content in a space (v2 GET /api/v2/spaces/{id}/content/labels). Cursor pagination via nextLink.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextLink.

prefix.description: Filter by label prefix, e.g. global.

page.ancestors.list.title: List Page Ancestors
page.ancestors.list.description: List ancestors of a page (v2 GET /api/v2/pages/{id}/ancestors). Takes limit only — no cursor.

limit.description: Maximum ancestors to return (v2 default 25, max 250).

page.inlineComments.list.title: List Page Inline Comments
page.inlineComments.list.description: List inline comments on a page (v2 GET /api/v2/pages/{id}/inline-comments). Cursor pagination via nextLink.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextLink.

status.description: Filter by comment status (string or array).

resolution_status.description: Filter by resolution status (string or array).

page.likes.count.title: Get Page Like Count
page.likes.count.description: Get the like count for a page (v2 GET /api/v2/pages/{id}/likes/count).

page.versions.list.title: List Page Versions
page.versions.list.description: List versions of a page (v2 GET /api/v2/pages/{id}/versions). Use this to learn the current version.number before page.update. Cursor pagination via nextLink.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextLink.

space.contents.list.title: Get Space Contents
space.contents.list.description: List content in a space by key (v1 GET /rest/api/space/{spaceKey}/content — v2 space content is split across /pages and /blogposts). type is page or blogpost. Offset pagination via start/limit.

cursor.description: Ignored by v1; prefer start/limit. Accepted for Composio compatibility.

space.properties.list.title: List Space Properties
space.properties.list.description: List properties on a space (v2 GET /api/v2/spaces/{id}/properties). id is the numeric space id. Cursor pagination via nextLink.

key.description: Filter by property key (string or array).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextLink.

tasks.list.title: List Tasks
tasks.list.description: List inline tasks / action items (v2 GET /api/v2/tasks). Filters accept a single id or an array. Cursor pagination via nextLink.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextLink.

page_id.description: Filter by page id (string or array).

task_id.description: Filter by task id (string or array).

space_id.description: Filter by space id (string or array).

created_by.description: Filter by creator account id (string or array).

assigned_to.description: Filter by assignee account id (string or array).

blogpost_id.description: Filter by blog post id (string or array).

completed_by.description: Filter by completer account id (string or array).

user.anonymous.get.title: Get Anonymous User
user.anonymous.get.description: Get the anonymous/guest user record (v1 GET /rest/api/user/anonymous — v2 has no anonymous-user endpoint).

search.content.title: Search Content
search.content.description: Search page titles via CQL (v1 GET /rest/api/search). Builds cql as title ~ "{query}". Optional spaceKey is sent as cqlcontext. For full-text body search use search.cql. Offset pagination via start/limit.

query.description: Title search text. Interpolated into CQL as title ~ "query".

cursor.description: Ignored by this v1 call; prefer start/limit.

spaceKey.description: Optional space key narrowing, sent as cqlcontext.

search.pages.title: Search Pages
search.pages.description: Filter pages (v2 GET /api/v2/pages) by exact title, space_id, and status. For full-text search use search.cql. Cursor pagination via nextLink.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextLink.

status.description: Page status. Comma-separated values are sent as-is.

search.spaces.title: Search Spaces
search.spaces.description: Filter spaces (v2 GET /api/v2/spaces) by type, status, labels, and keys. query is accepted for Composio compatibility but the v2 list endpoint has no text-search parameter — use keys or labels, or search.cql with type=space.

query.description: Unused by the v2 list endpoint; prefer keys/labels or search.cql.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextLink.

spaceKey.description: Filter by space key (string or array).

search.users.title: Search Users
search.users.description: Search users (v1 GET /rest/api/search/user). cql is required by the API (e.g. type=user or user.accountid=\"5b10...\"). accountId is accepted as a convenience: when cql is omitted, pass cql=user.accountid=\"{accountId}\". Offset pagination via start/limit, not cursor.

cql.description: User CQL, e.g. type=user AND user.fullname ~ "Ada".

accountId.description: Optional account id. Prefer encoding it in cql as user.accountid="...".

blogpost.update.title: Update Blog Post
blogpost.update.description: Update a blog post (v2 PUT /api/v2/blogposts/{id}). Optimistic concurrency: version.number must be the current version plus one. spaceId is required by Composio and sent in the body.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version. number is the current version plus one.

blogpost.property.update.title: Update Blog Post Property
blogpost.property.update.description: Update a blog post property by numeric property id (v2 PUT /api/v2/blogposts/{id}/properties/{propertyId}). key and version are optional extras the v2 body accepts.

key.description: Property key. Required by some v2 payloads.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version. number is the current version plus one.

page.property.update.title: Update Page Property
page.property.update.description: Update a page content property by numeric property id (v2 PUT /api/v2/pages/{pageId}/properties/{propertyId}).

key.description: Property key. Required by some v2 payloads.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version. number is the current version plus one.

whiteboard.property.update.title: Update Whiteboard Property
whiteboard.property.update.description: Update a whiteboard content property by numeric property id (v2 PUT /api/v2/whiteboards/{whiteboardId}/properties/{propertyId}).

key.description: Property key. Required by some v2 payloads.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version. number is the current version plus one.

space.property.update.title: Update Space Property
space.property.update.description: Update a space property by numeric property id (v2 PUT /api/v2/spaces/{spaceId}/properties/{propertyId}). spaceId is the numeric space id.

key.description: Property key. Required by some v2 payloads.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version. number is the current version plus one.

task.update.title: Update Task
task.update.description: Update a task's status (v2 PUT /api/v2/tasks/{id}). Only status is writable.

body_format.description: Optional body representation on the response.
